structuredContent.content:
name: trnm-required-baseline
on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: portable-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  # Preserve running head/merge evidence when a successor enters the queue.
  cancel-in-progress: false
env:
  CI: "true"
  CARGO_INCREMENTAL: "0"
  CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: "2"
  RUST_TEST_THREADS: "1"
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: never
  PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: "1"
  TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
jobs:
  repository-truth:
    name: repository-truth
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact candidate
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Verify immutable source identity
        run: python3 scripts/ci/verify_ci_source.py --kind head --expected-head "$TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-observations/source.json"
      - name: Set isolated Cargo paths after runner allocation
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          printf 'CARGO_HOME=%s/cargo-%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" "$GITHUB_JOB" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf 'CARGO_TARGET_DIR=%s/target-%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" "$GITHUB_JOB" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf 'TRNM_CI_RECEIPT_DIR=%s/ci-observations\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Check PQ provider CI wiring and failure controls
        run: python3 scripts/ci/test_pq_provider_ci.py
      - name: Check original public Host CI ownership and failure controls
        run: python3 scripts/ci/test_from_zero_host_ci.py
      - name: Run actual repository-truth checks
        run: bash scripts/ci/ci_job.sh repository-truth
      - name: Verify source remained unchanged
        if: always()
        run: python3 scripts/ci/verify_ci_source.py --kind head --expected-head "$TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA"
      - name: Retain source and execution observations
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: head-${{ github.job }}-${{ env.TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/ci-observations/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
  cross-arch-cost:
    name: cross-arch-cost (${{ matrix.arch }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 155
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - arch: x64
            runner: ubuntu-24.04
          - arch: arm64
            runner: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    env:
      TRNM_COST_RUNNER_LABEL: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact candidate
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Verify immutable source identity
        run: python3 scripts/ci/verify_ci_source.py --kind head --expected-head "$TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-observations/source.json"
      - name: Set isolated Cargo paths after runner allocation
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          printf 'CARGO_HOME=%s/cargo-%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" "$GITHUB_JOB" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf 'CARGO_TARGET_DIR=%s/target-%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" "$GITHUB_JOB" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf 'TRNM_CI_RECEIPT_DIR=%s/ci-observations\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Install pinned native release compiler
        run: rustup toolchain install 1.95.0 --profile minimal
      - name: Install matching native formatter
        run: rustup component add --toolchain 1.95.0 rustfmt
      - name: Execute native release setup and repeated-search costs
        run: env -u CARGO_INCREMENTAL python3 scripts/ci/run_cross_arch_cost.py --arch "${{ matrix.arch }}"
      - name: Execute native zero-matrix locality costs
        if: always()
        run: env -u CARGO_INCREMENTAL python3 scripts/ci/run_cross_arch_cost.py --arch "${{ matrix.arch }}" --suite zero-locality --zero-version 2
      - name: Execute native one-zero rank-one locality costs
        if: always()
        run: env -u CARGO_INCREMENTAL python3 scripts/ci/run_cross_arch_cost.py --arch "${{ matrix.arch }}" --suite one-zero-locality
      - name: Execute native fixed maintenance producer and preparation costs
        if: always()
        run: env -u CARGO_INCREMENTAL python3 scripts/ci/run_cross_arch_cost.py --arch "${{ matrix.arch }}" --suite maintenance-paired
      - name: Execute native legal and late-rejection verifier costs
        if: always()
        run: python3 scripts/pon_work_rejection_report.py --run --out "$TRNM_CI_RECEIPT_DIR/work-rejection"
      - name: Execute exact native from-zero service controls
        if: always()
        run: python3 scripts/ci/run_from_zero_host.py -- python3 scripts/ci/run_from_zero_native.py --out "$TRNM_CI_RECEIPT_DIR/from-zero-native"
      - name: Verify source remained unchanged
        if: always()
        run: python3 scripts/ci/verify_ci_source.py --kind head --expected-head "$TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA"
      - name: Retain native cost successes and failures
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: cost-${{ matrix.arch }}-${{ env.TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/ci-observations/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
  cross-arch-w1-reuse-v3:
    name: W1 actual reuse V3 (${{ matrix.arch }}, ${{ matrix.source }})
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 155
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        arch: [x64, arm64]
        source: [head, prospective-merge]
        include:
          - arch: x64
            runner: ubuntu-24.04
          - arch: arm64
            runner: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    env:
      TRNM_COST_RUNNER_LABEL: ${{ matrix.runner }}
      TRNM_COST_SOURCE_KIND: ${{ matrix.source }}
      TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ matrix.source == 'head' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      TRNM_EXPECTED_CANDIDATE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
      TRNM_EXPECTED_BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact candidate
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Verify V3 exact source and ordered merge before execution
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          args=(--kind "$TRNM_COST_SOURCE_KIND" --expected-head "$TRNM_EXPECTED_CANDIDATE_SHA")
          if test "$TRNM_COST_SOURCE_KIND" = prospective-merge; then
            args+=(--expected-base "$TRNM_EXPECTED_BASE_SHA" --expected-merge "$TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA")
          fi
          python3 scripts/ci/verify_ci_source.py "${args[@]}" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-observations/source-before.json"
      - name: Check original repository boundary before native V3 build
        run: bash scripts/project-preflight.sh --audit
      - name: Set isolated Cargo paths after runner allocation
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          printf 'CARGO_HOME=%s/cargo-%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" "$GITHUB_JOB" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf 'CARGO_TARGET_DIR=%s/target-%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" "$GITHUB_JOB" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf 'TRNM_CI_RECEIPT_DIR=%s/ci-observations\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Install pinned native release compiler
        run: rustup toolchain install 1.95.0 --profile minimal
      - name: Install matching native formatter
        run: rustup component add --toolchain 1.95.0 rustfmt
      - name: Execute the complete native W1 actual reuse V3 grid
        run: env -u CARGO_INCREMENTAL python3 scripts/ci/run_w1_reused_cost_v3.py --arch "${{ matrix.arch }}"
      - name: Verify V3 exact source and ordered merge after execution
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          args=(--kind "$TRNM_COST_SOURCE_KIND" --expected-head "$TRNM_EXPECTED_CANDIDATE_SHA")
          if test "$TRNM_COST_SOURCE_KIND" = prospective-merge; then
            args+=(--expected-base "$TRNM_EXPECTED_BASE_SHA" --expected-merge "$TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA")
          fi
          python3 scripts/ci/verify_ci_source.py "${args[@]}" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-observations/source-after.json"
      - name: Retain V3 costs including all failed observations
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: w1-reuse-v3-${{ matrix.source }}-${{ matrix.arch }}-${{ env.TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/ci-observations/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
  cross-arch-cost-consistency:
    name: cross-arch-cost-consistency
    needs: cross-arch-cost
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact candidate
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Verify immutable source identity
        run: python3 scripts/ci/verify_ci_source.py --kind head --expected-head "$TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-observations/source.json"
      - name: Retrieve both actual cost observations from this run
        uses: actions/download-artifact@634f93cb2916e3fdff6788551b99b062d0335ce0
        with:
          pattern: cost-*-${{ env.TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/cost-inputs/
          merge-multiple: false
      - name: Check actual streams and source identity without a speed threshold
        run: python3 scripts/ci/check_cross_arch_cost.py --artifacts "$RUNNER_TEMP/cost-inputs" --expected-source "$TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-observations/cross-arch-comparison.json"
      - name: Check zero-matrix streams and exact source identity
        if: always()
        run: python3 scripts/ci/check_cross_arch_cost.py --artifacts "$RUNNER_TEMP/cost-inputs" --expected-source "$TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-observations/cross-arch-zero-locality-comparison.json" --suite zero-locality --zero-version 2
      - name: Check one-zero rank-one streams and exact source identity
        if: always()
        run: python3 scripts/ci/check_cross_arch_cost.py --artifacts "$RUNNER_TEMP/cost-inputs" --expected-source "$TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-observations/cross-arch-one-zero-locality-comparison.json" --suite one-zero-locality
      - name: Check fixed maintenance streams and exact source identity
        if: always()
        run: python3 scripts/ci/check_cross_arch_cost.py --artifacts "$RUNNER_TEMP/cost-inputs" --expected-source "$TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-observations/cross-arch-maintenance-comparison.json" --suite maintenance-paired
      - name: Check actual rejection stages and paired native architectures
        if: always()
        run: python3 scripts/pon_work_rejection_report.py --compare "$RUNNER_TEMP/cost-inputs/cost-x64-$TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA-$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT/work-rejection" "$RUNNER_TEMP/cost-inputs/cost-arm64-$TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA-$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT/work-rejection" --expected-source "$TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA" --expected-run "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" --expected-attempt "$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-observations/work-rejection-comparison"
      - name: Verify source remained unchanged
        if: always()
        run: python3 scripts/ci/verify_ci_source.py --kind head --expected-head "$TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA"
      - name: Retain comparison result including missing or failed architectures
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: cost-consistency-${{ env.TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/ci-observations/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
  protocol-contract:
    name: protocol-contract
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact candidate
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Verify immutable source identity
        run: python3 scripts/ci/verify_ci_source.py --kind head --expected-head "$TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-observations/source.json"
      - name: Set isolated Cargo paths after runner allocation
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          printf 'CARGO_HOME=%s/cargo-%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" "$GITHUB_JOB" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf 'CARGO_TARGET_DIR=%s/target-%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" "$GITHUB_JOB" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf 'TRNM_CI_RECEIPT_DIR=%s/ci-observations\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Install pinned compiler and tools in isolated hosted runner
        run: |
          rustup toolchain install 1.95.0 --profile minimal --component rustfmt --component clippy
      - name: Install isolated conformance-only Python environment
        run: |
          python3 -m venv "$RUNNER_TEMP/pon-contract-env"
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/pon-contract-env/bin/python" -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --only-binary=:all: -r formal/pon-nakamoto-v1/requirements.txt
          echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/pon-contract-env/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
      - name: Prepare pinned OpenSSL 3.5.9 PQ provider
        shell: bash
        run: bash scripts/ci/prepare_pq_provider.sh
      - name: Run actual protocol-contract checks
        run: bash scripts/ci/ci_job.sh protocol-contract
      - name: Verify source remained unchanged
        if: always()
        run: python3 scripts/ci/verify_ci_source.py --kind head --expected-head "$TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA"
      - name: Retain source and execution observations
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: head-${{ github.job }}-${{ env.TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/ci-observations/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
  fuzz-smoke:
    name: fuzz-smoke
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact candidate
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Verify immutable source identity
        run: python3 scripts/ci/verify_ci_source.py --kind head --expected-head "$TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-observations/source.json"
      - name: Set isolated Cargo paths after runner allocation
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          printf 'CARGO_HOME=%s/cargo-%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" "$GITHUB_JOB" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf 'CARGO_TARGET_DIR=%s/target-%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" "$GITHUB_JOB" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf 'TRNM_CI_RECEIPT_DIR=%s/ci-observations\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Install pinned compiler and tools in isolated hosted runner
        run: |
          rustup toolchain install 1.95.0 --profile minimal --component rustfmt --component clippy
      - name: Install pinned coverage-guided fuzz tools
        run: bash scripts/ci/install_ci_tools.sh fuzz
      - name: Run actual fuzz-smoke checks
        run: bash scripts/ci/ci_job.sh fuzz-smoke
      - name: Verify source remained unchanged
        if: always()
        run: python3 scripts/ci/verify_ci_source.py --kind head --expected-head "$TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA"
      - name: Retain source and execution observations
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: head-${{ github.job }}-${{ env.TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/ci-observations/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
  rust-baseline-shards:
    name: rust-baseline shard (${{ matrix.shard }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 180
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [runtime, quality]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact candidate
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Verify immutable source identity
        run: python3 scripts/ci/verify_ci_source.py --kind head --expected-head "$TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-observations/source.json"
      - name: Set isolated Cargo paths after runner allocation
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          printf 'CARGO_HOME=%s/cargo-%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" "$GITHUB_JOB" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf 'CARGO_TARGET_DIR=%s/target-%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" "$GITHUB_JOB" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf 'TRNM_CI_RECEIPT_DIR=%s/ci-observations\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Install pinned compiler and tools in isolated hosted runner
        run: |
          rustup toolchain install 1.95.0 --profile minimal --component rustfmt --component clippy
      - name: Install pinned dependency auditor
        run: bash scripts/ci/install_ci_tools.sh supply-chain
      - name: Install isolated signed-state oracle Python environment
        run: |
          python3 -m venv "$RUNNER_TEMP/pon-state-env"
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/pon-state-env/bin/python" -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --only-binary=:all: -r formal/pon-nakamoto-v1/requirements.txt
          echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/pon-state-env/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
      - name: Prepare pinned OpenSSL 3.5.9 PQ provider
        shell: bash
        run: bash scripts/ci/prepare_pq_provider.sh
      - name: Run retained Rust shard
        run: python3 scripts/ci/rust_baseline_shards.py run --kind head --candidate "$TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA" --tested "$TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA" --shard "${{ matrix.shard }}" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-observations/rust-shard.json"
      - name: Verify source remained unchanged
        if: always()
        run: python3 scripts/ci/verify_ci_source.py --kind head --expected-head "$TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA"
      - name: Retain source and execution observations
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: rust-observations-head-${{ env.TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/ci-observations/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
      - name: Retain lightweight exact Rust shard proof
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: rust-shard-head-${{ env.TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/ci-observations/rust-shard.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/ci-observations/rust-shard.sh
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
  rust-baseline:
    name: rust-baseline
    needs: rust-baseline-shards
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 180
    env:
      TRNM_RUST_SHARD_RESULT: ${{ needs.rust-baseline-shards.result }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact tested source
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Verify immutable source identity
        run: python3 scripts/ci/verify_ci_source.py --kind head --expected-head "$TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-observations/source.json"
      - name: Retrieve both current-run Rust shard observations
        uses: actions/download-artifact@634f93cb2916e3fdff6788551b99b062d0335ce0
        with:
          pattern: rust-shard-head-${{ env.TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}-*
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/rust-shards/
          merge-multiple: false
      - name: Require both successful exact-source Rust shards
        if: always()
        run: python3 scripts/ci/rust_baseline_shards.py check --kind head --candidate "$TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA" --tested "$TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA" --inputs "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-shards" --dependency-result "$TRNM_RUST_SHARD_RESULT" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-observations/rust-fanin.json"
      - name: Verify source remained unchanged
        if: always()
        run: python3 scripts/ci/verify_ci_source.py --kind head --expected-head "$TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA"
      - name: Retain failed and successful Rust fan-in observations
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: rust-fanin-head-${{ env.TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/ci-observations/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
  prospective-rust-shards:
    name: prospective Rust shard (${{ matrix.shard }})
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 180
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [runtime, quality]
    env:
      TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
      TRNM_EXPECTED_CANDIDATE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
      TRNM_EXPECTED_BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact candidate
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Verify immutable source identity
        run: python3 scripts/ci/verify_ci_source.py --kind prospective-merge --expected-head "$TRNM_EXPECTED_CANDIDATE_SHA" --expected-base "$TRNM_EXPECTED_BASE_SHA" --expected-merge "$TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-observations/source.json"
      - name: Set isolated Cargo paths after runner allocation
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          printf 'CARGO_HOME=%s/cargo-%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" "$GITHUB_JOB" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf 'CARGO_TARGET_DIR=%s/target-%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" "$GITHUB_JOB" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf 'TRNM_CI_RECEIPT_DIR=%s/ci-observations\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Install pinned compiler and tools in isolated hosted runner
        run: |
          rustup toolchain install 1.95.0 --profile minimal --component rustfmt --component clippy
      - name: Install pinned dependency auditor
        run: bash scripts/ci/install_ci_tools.sh supply-chain
      - name: Install isolated signed-state oracle Python environment
        run: |
          python3 -m venv "$RUNNER_TEMP/pon-state-env"

    strategy:

    env:

        with:

        run: python3 scripts/ci/verify_ci_source.py --kind prospective-merge --expected-head "$TRNM_EXPECTED_CANDIDATE_SHA" --expected-base "$TRNM_EXPECTED_BASE_SHA" --expected-merge "$TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-observations/source.json"

          printf 'TRNM_CI_RECEIPT_DIR=%s/ci-observations\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Install isolated conformance and evidence Python environment
